headline: Oct 30: the whole money chain (U-005 to U-041) is in main and on production at ramble-sand.vercel.app, and a guest can hold a real session and reach checkout. A booking cannot confirm yet: after the fake Pay nothing delivers the payment event to the webhook intake (BC-38), and the fake gateway keeps its state in one process, so a second Vercel instance refuses it (BC-37). That glue is the last piece before the Monday Nov 2 click-through and nobody has started it; the e2e-money lane opens next. The forecast below was refit on Oct 30 with the money chain done; it prices units at estimate, so it is the slow case against agent actuals of 4 to 42 percent of estimate.
